TEXT:
I found out that I was in a storehouse at a certain 
port.
On a familiar coastline.

With a tower so high it could almost reach the 
moon.

Now that I know where I am, it was a fitting 
confinement site for kidnappings.

After Kaori had freed me, she sat next to me 
under the moonlight, and we stared out into the 
ocean.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
The thing about me, Kyousuke-kun... I am a person 
that should've been dead a long time ago.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That... does sound rather serious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Yes, indeed. At the time, it was an incurable illness.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I was told I wouldn't live past 20, when I was 6.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
And that was all I thought of it. Because I was a 
child. In all seriousness, it never really hit me that I 
would die in 14 years.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Well, my parents cried a lot though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
They cried so much that I couldn't bear it, so I just 
told them something.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What was it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
...Please be at ease, Father. I'll... live my life more 
happily than anyone else.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: -Or something like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That doesn't sound like you at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Of course not, how long ago do you think this is?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Anyway, I made a promise. From then on, I gave it 
my all to enjoy life to the fullest and played with all 
my might.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I played and played and played...

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Fortunately, this illness still allowed for a healthy 
lifestyle.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I made a checklist of everything I wanted to do 
before my death and started clearing them 
efficiently.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I studied, went on journeys, did sports, and fell in 
love.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I got into otaku stuff way after this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
During that time, I had my hands so full with my 
own life, that I couldn't care for my sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Just when I finally paid attention to her, my time 
was almost up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
At the time, Saori was just a kid who always 
looked bored.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Her face had "There is nothing fun in this world" 
written all over it, all depressed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: -I wanted to do something for her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I'm such an arrogant older sister, aren't I? 
Neglecting her for so long and then doing that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You really are. There's nothing wrong with Saori 
getting mad about that.
It hit close to home, but there's no helping it.

I knew I couldn't stand her because of how much 
we resembled each other.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Yeah, that's right. I really am.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Only worrying about Saori at that moment, wanting 
to do something for her. So... you took her out of 
the house.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Yeah. At the time the doctor had prohibited me 
from sports. So I thought I might try some indoor 
activities, like manga and games.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: And it occurred to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: If it's these activities, then I can hang out with her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I can teach Saori that there are fun things 
everywhere. Even create some precious memories 
with my little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I thought it was a great idea.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: ...But I failed.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
She said you forced her into your circle and left 
her there, even though she complained.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I didn't mean to! I just suck at dealing with kids!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I entrusted my little sister to Kanata, who had a 
little sister herself, and Saori got completely 
attached to her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I then became unwanted.
That does happen sometimes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I was really lonely.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I couldn't do anything else, so I played games while 
sulking alone.
And that's how she started hating you.
A vicious cycle.
This older sister was at the end of her rope.

This feeling of helplessness... I can't think of it as 
someone else's problem.
I see now.

Both of these sisters passed by each other just like 
that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
So you broke up the circle because of your illness, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Even though it was rude to everyone, I thought it 
was the right time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I still had to... get married, bear a child, push 
everything onto my husband and then die, or at 
least that was the plan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Even in the slightest chance that wasn't a joke, 
that's a horrible thing to say.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I didn't even have much time left to have such silly 
conversations with my husband.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I had done everything I had wanted to. I still had 
some regrets, but I gave it my best.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: ...It was a good life.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: I had accepted that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
But, the fact that you're here now means you're 
healed?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I was completely cured. Medical advances truly are 
amazing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Lame lol. It all turned out so messy lolol.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Shut up! This was supposed to be a moving scene!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
My first love became a doctor to cure me, and he 
is now my husband.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So he's the one who cured you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: No, he didn't.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: This story has a couple of loose ends.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Things don't work out like they do in dramas.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: In reality, things don't always work out.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: They don't work out, leaving much to be desired.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I did everything I wanted to, completed all my 
goals in life-

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: And yet I escaped the clutches of death.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
What should I do from now on? I didn't have any 
idea.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: It's like completely finishing an RPG.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
I defeated the secret boss, got to the max level, 
obtained all items... what else is there?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: There are still some things you have left to do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Isn't that why you came back to Japan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: You really are a strange man.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
You're so dull, and yet I don't feel like you're a 
stranger.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's because we're both in the siscon alliance.
Kaori looked up into the night sky, and she smiled.
